title: JAATI HAI NABI ZAADIYAN AB LUTT KE WATAN KO
body:
JAATI HAI NABI ZAADIYAN AB LUTT KE WATAN KO.
YE KISKI NAZAR KHAGAYI ZEHRA KE CHAMAN KO.
1. KUBRA NE KAHA BOLIYE AB KISKE SAHARE.
AYE IBNE HASAN CHOOD GAYE APNI DULHAN KO.
<<DIVIDER>>
2. HAATON PE SHAIHEY WAALA KE MAARA GAYA BESHEER.
PAANI BHI MAYASSAR NA HUWA TASHNADAHAN KO.
<<DIVIDER>>
3. MAZLOOM KA LAASHA THA PADA JALTI ZAMEEN PAR.
HASRAT SE BEHAN DEKHTI THI SHAHE ZAMAN KO.
<<DIVIDER>>
4. DARIYA KI TARAF DEKH KE ZAINAB NE SADA DI.
AB AAKEY AAMARI MAY BITHAO TOU BEHAN KO.
<<DIVIDER>>
5. QABR E SHAHEY WAALA PE KAHA BINTE ALI NE.
AYE BHAI ZARA DEKHIYE AB UTHH KE BEHAN KO.
<<DIVIDER>>
6. SEENE MAY JAWAAN LAAL KE PAIWAST JO DEKHI.
MEHSOOS HARAM KARTE HAIN WO BARCHI KI CHUBHAN KO.
<<DIVIDER>>
7. SHAI NE KAHA ZAINAB SE YEH SAR PEET KE SAAHIL.
PAAMAL LAAENO NE KIYA IBNE HASAN KO.
AZZ:ALAMDAR SAAHIL
